verdict.rationale: SigNoz has no documented native feature that generates incident or alert summaries. Instead, it exposes alerts, metrics, logs and traces to external AI agents (Claude, Cursor, Copilot and others) through its official MCP server and Agent Skills. It also documents AI use cases such as investigating what changed after a deploy, tuning a noisy alert and reconstructing a bug from a trace ID. Responders can get AI-assisted alert context only by bringing their own agent. Missing for 10: native in-product AI incident/alert summaries, AI context attached to alert notifications for responders, detailed docs or hands-on corroboration of summary quality.
